name: PWF's First Show

date.source: The promotion's own show report, posted the same day.

evidence.note: The promotion's first-ever card, three matches, posted by its own general manager.

matches.note: PWF's first-ever match. Pedro Ribeiro defeated Vítor Martins by TKO (5:32).
Tiago "The" Master defeated Cláudio and Hélder "The Player" together, submitting Cláudio with a Cobra Clutch (8:23).
Main event, "Two Titans Collide". "The Legend" Bruno defeated Johny "The Killer" with a top-rope Double Arm DDT (15:49), after Bé knocked Johny out with a steel chair behind the referee's back.

appearances.source: PWF's own show report, served at /promotions/pw-fusion-2009/archive/pwf-first-show-2009-11-14.html: Bé's ringside interference in the main event.
